CustomField.label: Installment Amount
CustomField.description: Computed by RES_ResidentialBundlePricingHook as RES_Installment_Percentage__c x the selected parent payment plan's price. Display-only - never read by pricing, so it is never double-counted in the bundle total (the installment's own price stays "Included" via ProductRelatedComponent.DoesBundlePriceIncludeChild).
